description: This source file defines the 'LinkAnnotations' class which demonstrates creating various link and annotation elements in a PDF document using the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for adding hyperlinks, rubber stamp annotations, and text annotations, as well as rendering these elements on a PDF page.

classes.name: LinkAnnotations
classes.description: A class demonstrating the use of link annotations and various PDF annotations such as rubber stamps and text notes in PDFsharp.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Main method rendering various link and annotation elements on a PDF page.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Creates and adds a hyperlink annotation of specified type (document, file, web) to the PDF page.
